Method of Attack: Exploiting a command injection vulnerability (CVE-2021-41653) in TP-Link TL-WR840N EU V5 routers to execute commands remotely
Downloading and executing malicious scripts (tshit.sh) to fetch payloads
Blocking connections to commonly targeted ports to prevent other botnets
Waiting for commands from C&C server to perform DoS attacks
Discoverer: Researcher who published the proof of concept exploit
Attack Vector: Authenticated command injection exploiting vulnerable 'host' variable
Default credentials on devices allowing trivial exploitation
